comment: ANCHOR: SCOPE_GOVERNOR_CRONTAB_SNAPSHOT_LQ261 — LQ-20261107-261: the hardened health agent is denied `crontab -l` and the spool, so the scope governor reads the cron-written snapshot (lib.crontab_snapshot) instead of returning "" and failing open.
